parameters.content:
## SETUP — what this workflow is for

Workflow 1 only reads clean Question/Answer rows you type into Airtable. Real clients hand over messy files — PDFs, Word docs, plain text policy dumps. This workflow proves the same knowledge base can learn directly from those, no manual retyping into rows.

This workflow is Active — open the Form Trigger node, copy its **Production URL**, open it in a browser. Upload a PDF, .docx, or .txt file. Extracts the text, splits it into chunks, embeds each chunk, and inserts them into the SAME Supabase `documents` table Workflow 1 uses — so Workflow 2 (the live agent) searches both sources together automatically.

**This is ADDITIVE, not a rebuild** — unlike Workflow 1, it never wipes the table.

**Credentials wired**: Gemini Embeddings -> Google Gemini API (pinned to `models/gemini-embedding-001`). Store Document Chunks -> Supabase API (Support Agent Knowledge Base).

**Dimension fix, 2026-08-22**: this model outputs 3072-dimension vectors, not the 768 n8n's own node description claims. The Supabase `documents` table was originally built for 768 and every insert failed until the table itself was corrected (see `temp/outputs/supabase-fix-embedding-dimension.sql`) — the model was never wrong, the table was.

**Confirmed working**: "Load Uploaded Document"'s Input Data Field Name (`data`) doesn't actually need to match the real binary property name (which turned out to be `Document`, not `data`) — Load All Input Data mode picks up any binary attachment on the item regardless of key name. No fix needed there.

⚠️ Known limitation: no OCR — a scanned image PDF (not real selectable text) will extract empty. Typed/exported PDFs, Word docs, and plain text all work.

### 1. Upload
A simple web form — one file field. Submitting it starts this workflow with the file attached as binary data on the item. No Airtable row, no manual formatting required.

### 2. Chunk, Embed, Store
"Load Uploaded Document" auto-detects the file type (PDF/DOCX/TXT) and extracts its text, using "Split Document Text" to break it into ~1000-character chunks with 150-character overlap (so a fact split across a chunk boundary still appears whole in at least one chunk). Each chunk gets embedded and inserted into the same `documents` table Workflow 1 populates — additive, never wiped.

nodes.name: Load Uploaded Document
nodes.notes: CONFIRMED WORKING 2026-08-23 (see SETUP sticky): Input Data Field Name here says 'data', but the real binary property name is 'Document'. That mismatch does not matter — Load All Input Data mode picks up any binary attachment on the item regardless of key name. Proven live: 2 real documents ingested successfully.

nodes.name: Store Document Chunks
nodes.notes: Insert mode only — never wipes the table. Additive to whatever Workflow 1 already embedded.

nodes.name: Ingestion Complete
nodes.notes: Document's chunks are now searchable by Workflow 2. Check the Knowledge Base's new content by asking a question only this document could answer.

nodes.name: Ingestion Failed - Check Execution Log
nodes.notes: Open this execution and read the error on 'Store Document Chunks' — common causes: unsupported/corrupt file, empty extracted text (scanned image PDF with no OCR), or a Supabase auth issue.
